prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / style-transfer. Asset type: transparent Galactic Empire colony-map building sprites for a Star Wars browser strategy game.
Input image: APPROVED IMPERIAL STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Preserve its cool medium-light gray armored steel/duracrete, graphite-black technical panels, sparse red lights, maintained weathering, crisp detail and broad readable footprint. Create NEW function-specific buildings with matching materials, never reuse the sample subjects.
Camera: high near-overhead ORTHOGRAPHIC, roofs dominate and front walls are shallow; same camera and scale as the reference. Broad low colony parcels with attached compact functional foundations. No tall monuments, perspective scene or collectible isometric miniature.
Lighting: soft uniform upper-left light, controlled contact shadows, enough light-gray roof area to read against existing terrain and dark UI.
Transparent background with genuine alpha around each structure, no fog, vignette, checkerboard, landscape or full ground rectangle. No text, logo, border, watermark, actors, people, animals, vehicles, spacecraft or scenery. No tan sandstone or rust-orange rebel architecture. Small functional glass/heat/ore color accents only where specified. Match readability at 40/68 pixels.
Layout: EXACTLY FOUR compounds, 2x2 grid on 1024x1024. Each occupies only its own 512x512 quadrant, approximately 450x450 subject with 20px transparent clearance. Order TOP LEFT, TOP RIGHT, BOTTOM LEFT, BOTTOM RIGHT.
1. Mandalorian grog distillery: compact Imperial gray production hall with three recognizable distillation towers and pipe loops, enclosed fermenting units and orderly small barrel/canister storage. Low towers, restrained muted copper machinery details, no tavern scene.
2. Cantina: low angular Imperial civilian mess-and-social building, broad central roof and two attached service wings around an orderly compact entrance courtyard; gray steel, narrow warm amber windows and tiny red access lights. No people, banners or text.
3. Imperial military academy: broad disciplined training campus with a square central administration block, two symmetric classroom wings, a compact empty drill courtyard and low security posts. Strong severe Imperial geometry, no gun turrets or soldiers.
4. Spaceport: low angular gray passenger terminal with two attached small EMPTY circular transfer pads, black framed covered passages, orderly cargo logistics annex and tiny red warning lamps. No ships or vehicles.
